name: Prompter
author: Dominic Boettger
description: Elgato Prompter control center for Omarchy. Eye-contact mirroring for video calls (your 4K screen share stays untouched), a native theme-aware teleprompter with markdown scripts, meeting autopilot, hotplug profiles per monitor setup, Stream Deck / keybinding control via IPC, and a setup doctor that automates the DisplayLink driver install.

barWidget.description: Eye-contact mirroring and teleprompting on an Elgato Prompter.
